inventory.visualPurpose: Functional anatomy of a eukaryotic gene and its expression flow
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: DNA→RNA→protein central-dogma strip above a gene schematic: enhancer/silencer upstream elements, promoter/TATA box, transcription start, exons (coding) alternating with introns, poly-A site; regulation labels for promoter/enhancer/silencer/epigenetics

notes: Original KYP adaptation re-lays the source's gene-anatomy + central-dogma composite as a KYP-native three-strip flow (DNA anatomy → pre-mRNA → mature mRNA → protein), preserving every labeled landmark (enhancer/silencer, CAAT, TATAAA, transcription start, GT…AG intron marks, 5′/3′ UTR, ORF, AATAAA/AAUAAA, poly-A tail).
